name: Agent Blueprint
description: Agent Blueprint® is software at https://app.agentblueprint.ai. A company builds a business profile and gets a ranked list of use cases and, for each one it picks, an agent design with a business case. Designs export as Agent Skills files and through an MCP server for coding agents. Access is by request. Self-serve signup is closed. Reviews and fixed-price engagements are offered by NowGentic (https://nowgentic.com), not by Agent Blueprint.

writing a one-page summary, agent card or charter for any agent
